feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Meta, TikTok and X lose hearing against UK watchdog over moderation data demands
articles.summary: Meta, ‌TikTok and X have lost a legal challenge against ‌the UK's regulator over the amount of information it is demanding under new laws.

articles.title: Yorkshire Water boss resigns after company given lowest environmental rating
articles.summary: Yorkshire Water has announced its chief executive is stepping down - a day after the company was given the lowest environmental rating by regulators.

articles.title: Poundland bidder tells administrator it remains keen on rescue deal
articles.summary: The Northern Irish company attempting to stage a solvent rescue of Poundland has told the discount retailer's administrator-in-waiting that it remains keen on a deal which could save more than 10,000 jobs.

articles.title: Homes evacuated and bomb squad called after 'neighbour dispute'
articles.summary: Homes have been evacuated while a bomb squad examines "small items" found by police after a row between neighbours.

articles.title: BP profits hit 18-year high as another bank makes billions
articles.summary: Profits at the UK-based oil and gas giant BP have hit an 18-year high, surpassing the level seen during the 2022 energy crisis.

articles.title: British student pilot among three killed in mid-air helicopter crash in US
articles.summary: Three people have been killed in a mid-air collision between two helicopters near a small airport in Oregon, police said.

articles.title: Star Trek and X-Men actor Sir Patrick Stewart dies
articles.summary: Star Trek and X-Men actor Sir Patrick Stewart has died after a "brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's and dementia.

articles.title: Met refers itself to police watchdog over handling of letter about Meghan's father
articles.summary: The Metropolitan Police has referred itself to the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) over a letter containing allegations about the Duchess of Sussex's father, Thomas Markle Snr.

articles.title: Lead, mercury and nicotine found in seized fake cosmetics
articles.summary: Seized counterfeit cosmetics have been found to contain lead, mercury and other potentially harmful substances - and are getting more common.

articles.title: 'Manosphere' as bad as tobacco for public health, report warns
articles.summary: Social media "manosphere" communities should be treated as a public health issue, a new report says - comparing them to the tobacco industry.
